topic.focus: alternative data sentiment signals: news, social media, web traffic
topic.angle: RavenPack sentiment, Reddit/Twitter mentions, Google Trends as momentum overlay

papers.title: News Momentum
papers.hypothesis: Rank stocks cross-sectionally by a 63-day rolling news-sentiment momentum score (RavenPack ESS/CSS aggregated to firm-level) with a 5-day skip, going long top decile; hard news releases drive 0.948%/month abnormal return (FF5-adjusted, 11.4% p.a.).
papers.rationale: RavenPack entity-level news sentiment aggregated over 63 trading days captures slow-moving information diffusion that is orthogonal to pure price momentum. The 5-day skip prevents reversal from short-term overreaction. Abnormal return survives FF5 and is not subsumed by the price-momentum factor, making it a genuine additive overlay.

papers.title: The Social Signal
papers.hypothesis: Use prior-5-day average firm-level Twitter/StockTwits sentiment (from Social Market Analytics) as a cross-sectional ranking overlay, but condition on message-volume spikes (top quintile activity) to filter noise; informativeness collapsed after the Jan-2021 GME episode.
papers.rationale: Pre-2021, Twitter+StockTwits sentiment predicted analyst forecast revisions and earnings, giving measurable cross-sectional alpha. Post-GME the paper documents a structural break: return sensitivity to sentiment dropped sharply, likely due to coordinated retail manipulation inflating signal noise. Useful as a cautionary parameter bound — if using social sentiment, require message-volume spike conditioning and backtest only on 2022+ data to avoid optimism bias from the pre-GME regime.

papers.title: Sentiment, Social Media, and Meme Stock Return Predictability
papers.hypothesis: Monthly identify meme-stock candidates via Reddit WSB textual mention counts; long the top-mentioned stocks produces positive alpha at 1-week horizon but significantly negative alpha beyond 1 month — usable as a short-side or avoidance screen in a cross-sectional momentum strategy.
papers.rationale: The paper shows Reddit-driven price inflation reverts sharply beyond 1-month, consistent with attention-driven mispricing. For a cross-sectional momentum strategy, flagging top-quintile Reddit-attention stocks as universe exclusions or downweights (rather than longs) could reduce drawdown from sentiment-induced momentum traps. The negative longer-horizon result is the actionable edge here.

papers.title: Google Search Volume Index and Investor Attention in Stock Market: A Systematic Review
papers.hypothesis: Construct a weekly attention-surge indicator per stock (Google Trends SVI z-scored over 52-week rolling window); stocks entering top-quintile attention (SVI z-score > 1.5) exhibit short-term return continuation of ~0.5–1% over the following 5–10 trading days before reversal — usable as a 2-week momentum accelerator overlay.
papers.rationale: The systematic review confirms GSVI significantly impacts short-term return predictability and liquidity across multiple markets; attention surges act as a catalyst that temporarily accelerates existing momentum. The 52-week normalization handles structural SVI level shifts. Combining an SVI-surge filter with price momentum lookback may improve the momentum signal-to-noise ratio by selecting stocks where investor attention is reinforcing rather than merely reflecting the price trend.

papers.title: Technical Patterns and News Sentiment in Stock Markets
papers.hypothesis: Combine a classical technical pattern signal (e.g., 52-week high proximity) with a concurrent 21-day news sentiment z-score; the joint signal — requiring both a bullish pattern AND positive sentiment z-score > 0.5 — yields higher Sharpe than either alone in cross-sectional long-short portfolios.
papers.rationale: The paper demonstrates that news sentiment and technical patterns are complementary rather than substitutes: technical patterns identify price structure while sentiment confirms narrative alignment, reducing false breakouts. A conjunction filter (both must be positive) approximately halves the long-list size but increases hit rate, which is directly actionable as an additional ranking dimension or as a confirmation gate on the existing momentum score in the current S10-005 architecture.
